title: Sturdy and looks good- a little low in height
text: Sturdy and looks good- a little low in height. Exactly what it looks like- great desk. Bought it for an online training desk at work. It is short for the average man so make sure you have chairs that either don’t have arms or have very low arms. Solid and sturdy.
